decisions: The P3 RuleConditionalMove single-predecessor bail is a FAITHFUL port of upstream Ghidra (`if (inblock->sizeIn() != 1) return 0;`), so this ships as a feature behind an option, not as a bug fix.

The literal P3 relaxation is not implementable: the constant arm's extra predecessor is a DIFFERENT CBRANCH whose boolean does not dominate the join, so folding to zext(cond) would be an SSA violation, and reconstructing the whole chain would hoist a guarded load above its guard. The re-roll is expressible only after structuring, where the chain is one BlockCondition.

The condition component is REQUIRED to be a BlockCondition (a folded short-circuit chain), which is what makes the rewrite value-safe as well as shape-safe: `&&`/`||` (and the negating `!`) always yield 0/1 in C. A bare leaf condition renders truthy under DIV-37 (`if (x & 0x100)` -> `(x & 0x100)`), so `v = (x & 0x100)` would store 0x100 -- wrong code. The bare-leaf shape is also the one P3 already folds.
Pointer/float/aggregate destinations are declined (they would lose the constant's own rendering).
Print-only: an addl-flag (kuna_iteboolean, 0x4000) on the condition's terminal CBRANCH; no p-code is cloned or mutated, so OFF is byte-identical.
